intermediate_failure_causes: The new module is inside the cc_hhgt.v32 package, so the encoder helper needed two dots instead of three; eight checks that execute the contrast failed until the import depth was corrected.

Each control compared an intervened graph against an observed graph of a different structure, mixing the intervention with the structural edit; the attribution collapse to VALUE_ONLY_EFFECT exposed it and every control now recomputes the whole contrast inside its own structure.

Edge surgery matched one per-node-type index against the source index of every edge type, so it also removed or rewired edges that merely shared the same local index (4 edges instead of 2); surgery is now restricted to edge types whose source is the declared node type.

scope_limit: Patient-level conditioning now has a defined, executable and falsifiable contrast. For one declared patient, one protein node and one omics channel, the frozen model is evaluated twice with every other input held byte-identical, and the difference in the lncRNA-pathway membership logit is reported together with sign changes and within-cancer rank movement; the record states that this is a model-conditional interventional contrast, not a causal effect in patients. Interaction attribution adds the only controls that can falsify an interaction reading: a rewiring control that keeps edge type, count and weight while redirecting P to other partners, and a matched placebo node with no path to the pair. The verdict is restricted to within-frozen-model language and every record states that biological mediation is not proven. Cohort tables cannot stand in for patients, unmeasured participants are refused instead of imputed, a counterfactual equal to the observed value is refused, and the homogeneous model refuses edge surgery rather than silently skipping the controls. No optimizer, real cohort, paid compute or deployment ran; the fixture model is untrained and the synthetic deltas carry no biological meaning.
